question: Which mantra formula is assigned to the feet in the elemental placement?
premises: The formula includes kam and namaḥ.
It addresses the supreme self of the earth element.
The location specified is the feet.
inference: The mantra 'kam namaḥ parāya pṛthivītattvātmane namaḥ' is placed on the feet.
plain_english: On the feet, place: kam, obeisance to the supreme self of the earth element, obeisance.
